# QuickMoments — Full Platform Knowledge Base & Technical Documentation

Platform URL: https://www.quickmoment.fun/
Organization: QuickMoments Intelligence Team
Last Updated: September 2026

## 1. Executive Overview

QuickMoments is a modern high-performance web platform combining high-precision mathematical calculation suites, real-time market intelligence from The Economic Times and Yahoo Finance, and an academic-grade research journal.

All computations are executed 100% client-side in browser memory with zero server data retention, ensuring total user confidentiality for financial data, tax calculations, and medical/health metrics.

---

## 2. Core Pillar I: Real-Time Intelligence & Economic Times NewsRoom

URL: https://www.quickmoment.fun/newsroom

The QuickMoments NewsRoom aggregates, deduplicates, and categorizes real-time RSS feeds from **The Economic Times** and Google News, alongside live market tickers refreshed every 2 hours via Yahoo Finance APIs:

### Real-Time Market Tickers
- NIFTY 50 (National Stock Exchange of India)
- BSE SENSEX (Bombay Stock Exchange)
- S&P 500 & NASDAQ Composite (US Equities)
- USD/INR (Foreign Exchange Spot Rate)
- Brent Crude Oil ($/bbl)
- 24K Physical Gold (₹ per 10g)
- 10-Year Indian Government Sovereign Bond Yield (G-Sec)

### 5 Specialized News Divisions
1. **Technology & AI**: Semiconductor lithography (TSMC 2nm GAA, ASML EUV), Generative AI models, hyperscale cloud architecture, and cybersecurity.
2. **Stock Market & IPOs**: Dalal Street indices, primary market listings, institutional FII/DII liquidity, and company earnings.
3. **Economy & Macro**: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) repo rates, Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation, and GDP growth trajectories.
4. **Politics & Policy**: Indian Union Budget direct tax reforms, Capital Gains tax regulations, and Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes.
5. **Global & Geopolitics**: BRICS local currency settlement frameworks, global central bank reserve diversification, and supply chain trade corridors.

## 3. Core Pillar II: 15+ Precision Calculation Engines

### 1. Loan EMI Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/emi-calculator
- **Formula**: $$EMI = P \times r \times \frac{(1 + r)^n}{(1 + r)^n - 1}$$
- **Features**: Reducing balance monthly amortization schedule, extra monthly prepayment savings simulator, total interest breakdown.

### 2. SIP Compounding Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/sip-calculator
- **Formula**: $$M = P \times \frac{(1 + i)^n - 1}{i} \times (1 + i)$$
- **Features**: Step-up annual increase percentage, real inflation-adjusted wealth projection, visual growth trajectory.

### 3. Income Tax Calculator (FY 2025-26)
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/salary-calculator
- **Features**: Side-by-side comparison between New Tax Regime and Old Tax Regime with standard deduction of ₹75,000, Section 80C, 80D, HRA exemptions, and 4% Health & Education cess.

### 4. Compound Interest & Rule of 72 Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/compound-interest-calculator
- **Formula**: $$A = P \left(1 + \frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}$$
- **Features**: Frequency toggles (Daily, Monthly, Quarterly, Annually), deposit schedules, compounding power index.

### 5. CAGR (Compound Annual Growth Rate) Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/cagr-calculator
- **Formula**: $$CAGR = \left(\frac{V_{final}}{V_{begin}}\right)^{\frac{1}{t}} - 1$$

### 6. Retirement & FIRE Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/retirement-calculator
- **Features**: 4% safe withdrawal rule, life expectancy modeling, post-retirement monthly cash flow, corpus deficit estimation.

### 7. Rent vs Buy Decision Engine
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/rent-vs-buy-calculator
- **Features**: Down payment opportunity cost, home price appreciation, property taxes, maintenance fees vs rent inflation.

### 8. GST (Goods & Services Tax) Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/gst-calculator
- **Features**: Exact CGST + SGST (Intra-state) and IGST (Inter-state) breakdown across 5%, 12%, 18%, 28% slabs.

### 9. Monte Carlo Investment Simulator
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/simulations/monte-carlo-investment
- **Features**: 10,000 to 100,000 stochastic randomized market trials using Geometric Brownian Motion with drift and volatility parameters.

### 10. Clinical BMI, BMR & TDEE Health Suite
- **URL**: https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators/bmi-calculator
- **Features**: Mifflin-St Jeor and Katch-McArdle metabolic calculations, daily caloric deficit/surplus macronutrient planning.

## 4. Core Pillar III: Deep Research Blogs & Whitepapers

URL: https://www.quickmoment.fun/blog

1. **How Loan EMI is Calculated**: Frontloaded interest traps and the mathematical multiplier of 5% principal prepayments.
2. **SIP vs Lumpsum Historical Backtest**: 20-year empirical evaluation of Rupee Cost Averaging across bull and bear cycles.
3. **Monty Hall & Birthday Probability Paradoxes**: Counterintuitive Bayesian probability proofs and simulations.
4. **Old vs New Tax Regime Inflection Points**: Exact deduction thresholds where the Old Tax Regime outperforms the New Regime for FY 2025-26.
5. **Physics of 2nm GAA Transistors**: Gate-All-Around nanosheets, High-NA EUV lithography, and quantum tunneling limits.
6. **Quantum Computing & Shor's Algorithm**: Qubit superposition, entanglement, and post-quantum RSA cryptographic vulnerability.
7. **Dedollarization & BRICS Macroeconomics**: Bilateral currency clearing systems, petroyuan, and central bank gold accumulation.
8. **The Math of Compound Living**: Exponential growth in habits, skills, and financial capital via the Rule of 72.
9. **Capital Gains Tax (LTCG / STCG) Budget Reforms**: Updated holding periods, indexation removal impacts, and tax planning strategies.
10. **Algorithmic Trading & Order Book Microstructure**: Limit order books (LOB), bid-ask spread dynamics, market makers, and VWAP execution algorithms.
